```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(rtracklayer)   # Bioconductor: BiocManager::install(c("rtracklayer", "GenomicRanges"))
})
set.seed(42)
```

# Approach

1. Lift the first base of each IMPACT variant (VCF position) from hg19 to hg38 with the UCSC chain file.
2. Keep only variants that lift to exactly one position on the same strand.
3. Optionally check that the SNV reference base matches the hg38 reference.
4. Save the lifted file and a QC table. REF and ALT are not changed.

Download the chain file once (on a node with internet):

```bash
wget https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg19/liftOver/hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz
gunzip hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz
```

```{r paths}
impact_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MSK_IMPACT/pILC_IMPACT_filtered.tsv"
chain_file  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/Reference_genome/liftOver/hg19ToHg38.over.chain"   # set your path

# Optional: hg38 reference FASTA (with .fai index) for the REF-base check on SNVs.
# Leave as NA to skip the check.
ref_fasta   <- NA_character_

out_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MSK_IMPACT/pILC_IMPACT_filtered_hg38.tsv"
qc_file  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MSK_IMPACT/IMPACT_liftover_QC.tsv"

stopifnot(file.exists(impact_file), file.exists(chain_file))
```

```{r liftover}
imp <- fread(impact_file, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA"))
need <- c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT", "SYMBOL", "TUMOR_SAMPLE")
stopifnot(all(need %in% names(imp)))

imp[, row_id := .I]
imp[, chr_hg19 := paste0("chr", sub("^chr", "", CHROM))]

gr <- GRanges(seqnames = imp$chr_hg19,
              ranges = IRanges(start = as.integer(imp$POS), width = 1L))
chain <- import.chain(chain_file)
lifted <- liftOver(gr, chain)

n_hits <- lengths(lifted)
ok <- n_hits == 1L
ul <- unlist(lifted[ok])

imp[, `:=`(CHROM_hg38 = NA_character_, POS_hg38 = NA_integer_, strand_hg38 = NA_character_)]
imp[ok, CHROM_hg38   := sub("^chr", "", as.character(seqnames(ul)))]
imp[ok, POS_hg38     := start(ul)]
imp[ok, strand_hg38  := as.character(strand(ul))]

imp[, lift_status := fifelse(n_hits == 0L, "unmapped",
                      fifelse(n_hits > 1L, "multiple_hits",
                      fifelse(strand_hg38 == "-", "minus_strand", "lifted")))]

# Only plain lifted variants are usable for variant-level matching
imp[lift_status != "lifted", `:=`(CHROM_hg38 = NA_character_, POS_hg38 = NA_integer_)]

cat("Liftover status:\n")
print(imp[, .N, by = lift_status][order(-N)])
```

```{r reference_check}
# SNV REF-base check against hg38 (only if a FASTA is provided)
imp[, ref_check := NA_character_]

if (!is.na(ref_fasta) && file.exists(ref_fasta)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Rsamtools))
  fa <- FaFile(ref_fasta)
  snv <- imp[lift_status == "lifted" & nchar(REF) == 1L & nchar(ALT) == 1L]
  gr38 <- GRanges(paste0("chr", snv$CHROM_hg38), IRanges(snv$POS_hg38, width = 1L))
  ref38 <- as.character(getSeq(fa, gr38))
  imp[match(snv$row_id, row_id), ref_check := fifelse(toupper(ref38) == toupper(snv$REF), "match", "mismatch")]
  cat("\nSNV REF check against hg38:\n")
  print(imp[!is.na(ref_check), .N, by = ref_check])
  # Mismatching SNVs lifted badly: exclude them from variant-level matching
  imp[ref_check == "mismatch", `:=`(CHROM_hg38 = NA_character_, POS_hg38 = NA_integer_)]
} else {
  cat("\nref_fasta not set: REF-base check skipped.\n")
}
```

```{r gene_sanity}
# Gene-region sanity check: lifted CDH1 / TP53 / PIK3CA should be in hg38 gene regions.
# Approximate hg38 spans (Mb): CDH1 chr16 68.74-68.84, TP53 chr17 7.66-7.69, PIK3CA chr3 179.15-179.24
chk <- imp[SYMBOL %in% c("CDH1", "TP53", "PIK3CA") & lift_status == "lifted",
           .(CHROM_hg38 = CHROM_hg38[1], min_pos_Mb = round(min(POS_hg38) / 1e6, 3),
             max_pos_Mb = round(max(POS_hg38) / 1e6, 3), n = .N), by = SYMBOL]
print(chk)
```

```{r save}
qc <- imp[, .(n_variants = .N,
              n_lifted = sum(lift_status == "lifted"),
              n_unmapped = sum(lift_status == "unmapped"),
              n_multiple = sum(lift_status == "multiple_hits"),
              n_minus_strand = sum(lift_status == "minus_strand"),
              n_ref_mismatch = sum(ref_check == "mismatch", na.rm = TRUE))]
print(qc)

fwrite(qc, qc_file, sep = "\t")
fwrite(imp[, !c("row_id", "chr_hg19")], out_file, sep = "\t", na = "NA")
cat("\nSaved:\n", out_file, "\n", qc_file, "\n")
```
